description: Explains what a basic Refapp concept is, such as a project, candidate, referee, questionnaire, report or project template. Accepts the name in any of Refapp's languages (e.g. "Kandidat", "Prosjektmal") or a short question that names it. Returns the name in each language and what it means; when nothing matches, lists the known concepts.
name: explain_concept
title: Explain a Refapp concept
